name: Diarbbitmon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they have no unsuspended Digimon, gain 2 memory.
[When Attacking] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Angoramon] in its text from your hand without paying the cost. At the end of your opponent's turn, return that Digimon to the hand.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
set_name: LM-01: Limited Card Pack Digimon Ghost Game
